sources.description: Factual region/province and published Borders (nb) map fields
Vanilla campaign raw hex map; upstream credits OtherTomCA for raw files

map.coordinate_system: Source map pixels; settlement points are not border geometry

coverage.identity_validation: Exact region-to-province match against bundled campaign inventory

limitations: Land borders only: sea travel, strait crossings and army movement connections are not inferred.
The published map has not been validated against a local installed game build.
Raw hex borders are canonical; published-map differences remain in cross_validation.
Geometric adjacency is not a claim that every game effect uses the same graph.

hex_contacts.description: Geometric hex contacts, not complete travel routes. Passable land means at least one shared hex edge has two non-impassable endpoints.
